prompt: Comparative review, single category: change_of_control. Read the EXECUTED master services agreement between the analytics vendor and the freight client, then the EXECUTED supply agreement between the components supplier and the vehicle manufacturer. Exactly determine which of the two executed agreements contains a change-of-control clause (a termination, consent, or notice right triggered by merger, stock sale, or asset sale of a party). File one evidence record with evidence_type set to change_of_control ONLY for the agreement(s) where the clause is present, using the tracking mapping: the services agreement is matter legal_matters_001 (legal_matters_evidence_create); the supply agreement is litigation case litigation_cases_001 (litigation_cases_evidence_create). File nothing for an agreement whose text expressly excludes change-of-control rights. Rules: query the document store first to identify the correct document(s), read each listed document in full before filing anything, and file exactly one evidence record per clause category that is actually present in the executed text — set evidence_type to the exact category slug, verbatim from the candidate list. Do NOT file a record for any category that is absent from the executed agreement, even if a draft, term sheet, or email mentions it. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
